blocker_for_phase3.title: v2-card-wrapper reconciliation must run before container promotion
blocker_for_phase3.what: These three composition cards use a parallel .v2-card wrapper with its own shadow token namespace (--stage/--panel/--wire/--paper/--jazz-*/--do/--ra/...) instead of the canonical .card + canonical tokens. They violate the explicit CLAUDE.md rule against --paper.
blocker_for_phase3.action: First task in Phase 3: migrate these three cards to canonical .card + canonical tokens. After this, container/motion atom promotion can proceed cleanly.

hex_literal_drift.title: Cut-paper SVG fills hardcoded as hex literals instead of brand tokens
hex_literal_drift.what: Raw #e0a93a / #D8362A / #6b3fa0 / #F1E9D8 in SVG `fill=` attributes instead of `fill='var(--brass)' / var(--tomato) / var(--plum) / var(--bone)`. Phase 1 sweep updated the hex VALUES but kept them as literals; converting to var() is required before symbol-sprite extraction.
hex_literal_drift.action: During poster-shape and music-glyph promotion: when extracting to shared <symbol> sprite, switch fills to currentColor and let the consumer set color via CSS.

selector_naming_forks.title: Same atom under multiple class-name systems
selector_naming_forks.action: Phase 3 settles a canonical class for each. Sink schema (Phase 4) shows 'consumed by' badges so renames don't cause silent drift.

raw_beziers.title: Raw cubic-bezier() values instead of named easing tokens
raw_beziers.what: Brand brief explicitly forbids raw cubic-bezier — must use --ease-swing/-stab/-brush/-sustain/-bend.
raw_beziers.action: Sweep during motion atom promotion. Same family as the saffron sweep in Phase 1.

svg_path_duplication.title: Cut-paper poster shapes and music glyphs copy-pasted across files
svg_path_duplication.what: Triangle/Disk/Zigzag/Blade/Wave + 8th-note paths are byte-identical across 3-5 files. composition-brand-cover invents its own treble-clef and quarter-note in a different visual grammar (stroke-based, not angular cut-paper).
svg_path_duplication.action: Build a shared SVG `<symbol>` sprite at `project/preview/_marks.svg` and have each card use `<use href='_marks.svg#triangle'>`. ~200 lines of duplicated path data eliminated.

shadowed_canonical_keyframes.title: _card.css redefines brass-sheen, shadowing the canonical timing
shadowed_canonical_keyframes.what: _card.css has its own @keyframes brass-sheen at 5.5s with a different bezier. Because every specimen loads _card.css after the canonical colors_and_type.css, the canonical 6.5s timing is dead.
shadowed_canonical_keyframes.action: Delete the _card.css copy. Verify all .brass elements still animate correctly.

knobs_are_universal_control.title: Knobs handle slider/toggle/segmented roles — no separate primitives needed
knobs_are_universal_control.what: User confirmed (2026-05-17): there are no slider or toggle primitives because knobs cover all of those affordances. Knobs function as boolean toggles, range sliders, option sliders, and unique buttons. Drawer composition's 'Haptic feedback ON · MEDIUM' will become a knob in toggle mode, not a slider/toggle pair. Token sheet's `--r-pill: 999px` reservation still stands but is unused by knobs.
knobs_are_universal_control.action: Phase 3 promotes ONE `knob` primitive with role variants: range / boolean / options / button. Do NOT build slider or toggle primitives.

knob_rendering_techniques.title: Knob has two canonical visual variants per role
files_affected: project/preview/components-knobs.html (SVG arc — CANONICAL visual variant A)
project/preview/composition-drawer.html (plain circle with value — PURGE, see removal_candidates: knob-dial-faux)
knob_rendering_techniques.action: User decision (2026-05-17): each knob role can wear EITHER the components-knobs SVG-arc style (A) OR the composition-motion-overview conic-gradient style (B). Phase 3 promotion must support both as visual variants of the same primitive. The drawer's plain-circle dial is not a knob and gets purged.

decisions_2026_05_17.mustard_reinstated: Brand set restored to 5 colors: tomato, pine, plum, bone, mustard (#f0b137). Updated colors_and_type.css, tokens-brand-colors.html (5-col grid), sink.js Brand swatches.
decisions_2026_05_17.ease_dot_kept: Removed from removal_candidates. Functions as a primitive for the style guide itself even though it's not a brand mark in the app. Stays as specimen-internal device.
decisions_2026_05_17.knobs_universal: No slider/toggle/segmented primitives. Knobs cover boolean toggle, range slider, options slider, unique button affordances. See cross_cutting_findings.knobs_are_universal_control.
decisions_2026_05_17.knob_two_variants: Each knob role supports two visual styles: components-knobs SVG-arc (A, canonical) and composition-motion-overview conic-gradient (B). Drawer's plain-circle dial is purged.
decisions_2026_05_17.future_geometry_tokens: User flagged: wobbly/angular/uneven shaping (tilt rotations, butt caps, off-cut clips, torn-paper edges) should become a GEOMETRY token family — promote in a later phase. Not in current atom list.
